changelog:
Initial release of "karpathy-guidelines" skill.

- Introduces a set of concise behavioral guidelines to reduce common coding mistakes in LLM-driven code tasks.
- Emphasizes clarity of assumptions, simplicity in implementation, and making only targeted (surgical) code changes.
- Promotes explicit definition of success criteria and iterative goal-driven development.
- Based on publicly shared principles by Andrej Karpathy, adapted to guide coding, reviewing, or refactoring practices.
summary: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring code to avoid overcomplication, make surgical changes...
